headline: Verstappen starts his GT3 debut from 15th at Portimão, Anthropic's IPO price talk cools to $1.5tn, a theoretical carbon cousin of diamond finally gets made, and UFC Edmonton is on weight for tonight.

upcoming.what: GTWC Europe finale, 3 Hours of Portimão, 17:00–20:00 Irish time. Verstappen/Barnicoat/Lulham start 15th
UFC Edmonton: Buckley vs Malott. Prelims 22:00, main card 01:00 Irish time (Sunday morning)
WEC 6 Hours of Barcelona, 11:00–17:00 Irish time (Hyperpole Sat 15:00)
ID@Xbox indie showcase, broadcast by IGN
Orionid meteor shower peaks; best after midnight, though moonlight will hide the faint ones
F1 United States GP, Austin; UFC 333 Volkanovski vs Evloev on the 24th; Irish clocks go back on the 25th

items.headline: Verstappen's GT3 debut starts from 15th at Portimão
items.summary: A setup gamble backfired in qualifying: the Mercedes-AMG he shares with Barnicoat and Lulham was bottoming out and porpoising, ending up about half a second off the pole-sitting #2 Porsche. The three-hour GTWC Europe finale starts at 17:00 Irish time today.

items.headline: WEC Barcelona: Toyota's title fight goes down to the wire
items.summary: The #8 Toyota leads its sister #7 by 10 points with two rounds left, and BMW's pair sit third and fourth. Hyperpole is this afternoon and the six-hour race starts at 11:00 Irish time on Sunday.

items.headline: Lawson swaps helmet for guitar before Austin
items.summary: A lighter one: ahead of next weekend's US GP, Racing Bulls will put Liam Lawson on stage with a custom guitar at its Garage Sessions event. F1 itself is quiet this weekend.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO valuation talk slides to $1.5tn
items.summary: Some prospective investors are pushing for about $1.5tn rather than the $2tn floated earlier for next month's listing, after Q3 revenue growth slowed to 45% quarter-on-quarter (to $16.8bn). The company says it remains profitable on an adjusted basis.

items.headline: White House superintelligence task force starts its clock
items.summary: The new task force has adopted its charter and has 120 days to report on AI risks to cybersecurity, biosecurity and model control.

items.headline: Four DeepMind agents beat Minecraft from scratch
items.summary: A team of Gemini-based coding agents went from a random spawn to killing the Ender Dragon in about 27 hours, coordinating only through in-game chat and shared memory.

items.headline: Meta's new terms raise news-scraping alarm
items.summary: Legal experts say Meta's terms taking effect on 30 October would let it crawl sites linked to business accounts and use that content to train its products, with no opt-out.

items.headline: Dragon delivers the ISS's final roll-out solar arrays
items.summary: SpaceX's CRS-35 cargo Dragon docked on Thursday with over 2.8 tonnes of supplies, the last set of new solar arrays, and experiments ranging from artificial retina manufacturing to brain organoids.

items.headline: Diamondiyne: a carbon form predicted decades ago is finally made
items.summary: Gothenburg researchers built this porous 3D carbon, made of tetrahedral units joined by triple bonds, without the crushing pressures diamond needs. So far its crystal structure is confirmed only in tiny patches.

items.headline: Diamond electrons nudge a levitating device
items.summary: Physicists used spins inside a diamond to give a quantum push to a centimetre-scale floating object. It's a step towards experiments probing where quantum mechanics meets gravity.

items.headline: A star seen exploding in 1181 is still going
items.summary: Sharper observations of the remnant Pa 30 show about ten times more glowing filaments than previously seen, deepening the mystery of a 'zombie' star that survived its own supernova.

items.headline: Mark Darrah warns CD Projekt has little room for error
items.summary: The ex-BioWare producer argues that ballooning budgets for The Witcher 4 and the next Cyberpunk mean even a one-month slip now costs millions. It's commentary rather than news, but it's the only fresh watchlist item; nothing new on Witcher 3 or Borderlands since yesterday.

items.headline: Ocarina of Time remake shows more ahead of 5 November
items.summary: Nintendo's pre-order trailers include the Deku Tree, Volvagia and Epona, plus a first look at Dark Link, ahead of the Switch 2 launch next month.

items.headline: Japanese Ramen Simulator serves up 100k sales
items.summary: The indie sim hit six figures in its first week, and its developer has laid out a roadmap including noodle-making, new staff roles and a photo mode. Steam Next Fest demos are also live this week.

items.headline: IBJJF The Crown lineups take shape for 8 November
items.summary: Gabi Pessanha is going for a fourth straight Crown at super-heavyweight, still unbeaten at the event. Three-time champion Erich Munis is doubtful after surgery, and featherweight champ Cole Abate won't defend. Otherwise a quiet week on the mats.

items.headline: UFC Edmonton: all 26 fighters on weight
items.summary: Buckley and Malott both came in at 170.5 for tonight's five-round welterweight main event, and the whole card made weight without a miss. No Irish or UK fighters on this one.

items.headline: Blanchfield vs Jasudavicius is the co-main
items.summary: A meaningful women's flyweight fight: Erin Blanchfield, a former title challenger, faces home favourite Jasmine Jasudavicius. Main card from 01:00 Irish time.
